scene toukadownstairs1
We’re ushered through a winding hallway toward a set of stairs that seldom sees sentience. Each step feels like a promise. Each promise is immediately broken.

I have trouble focusing on what exactly is happening. It all feels surreal. I’d resigned myself to the idea that this place was little more than a shell to house delusions in. Now the shell is gaining a mind of its own.
The torches on the walls, rarely ever lit as I can only imagine, lock the eyes they shouldn’t have on me and ask me why I’m going along with this.

It’s like they have seen what has transpired in the lower plane and want to silently talk me out of it. But I am unable to respond. I merely look at them and return the silence — asking why they care.

All the while, a hand rests on my shoulder and forces me down further, uncaring that the torches talk. And there is nothing I can do to change that as it stems from a mind with its roots already sunken in.

The death grip they have on my legs makes it feel as if those arboreal veins have become the laces of my shoes — and they attempt to pull me down only to be met with instant gratification and prophesied success.
There is nothing I can do to stop what is coming. That is something I have resigned myself to as well. Long before I knew this place existed. Long before I knew she existed.
This peculiar half-mento. Those blinding blue eyes that can peer through my armor and dissolve my resolve.
I want to break her open to see what’s inside. I can only imagine what colors would spill out.
: Almost there! Almost there!
scene toukadownstairs2
: Almost where, Yasu? Are you escorting us to some sort of...ritualistic room? Where this apparent vow must take place?
: Yes! Exactly! I heard Him just now, Touka! He told me where to take you! He says my wings are naught more than a whale away!
: He measures things in whales?
: Whales, tails, the shells of snails! As pale as Michael’s bed of nails!
scene toukadownstairs3
: Oh, why didn’t you just say so? I completely understand now.
: Do you understand as well, little lamb? Before we turn your legs to meat, you must feast on wheat! We beg you, eat!
scene toukadownstairs4
: Silence, violence, noncompliance. How shall I guide who seeks no guidance?
: I believe an effective place to start would be not mentioning that you want to turn his lamb legs into meat.
: Is this really part of the game, Yasu?
: This is the game.
scene toukadownstairs5
: YOU ARE GOING TO HAVE SO MUCH FUN!
scene toukadownstairs6
: What...is this, Yasu?
: I’m pretty sure it’s a jail cell.
: I’m aware of what it appears to be. But I don’t believe that churches typically double as prisons.
: This is no prison. This is salvation.
scene toukadownstairs7
: This is a chance to be reborn!
scene toukadownstairs8
: Why you- Yasu! What the hell do you think you’re doing?! Unlock this blasted cell at once! You said you were bringing us here to make a vow! Not to keep us as prisoners!
: You’re not prisoners, Touka! Prisoners don’t have the luxury of deciding when to leave! You do!
: Excellent! I would like to leave now!
scene toukadownstairs9
: Okay!
: Oh. Was it...was it really that easy?
: It will be! You just have to complete the vow.
scene toukadownstairs10
: Hah...fine.
: I, Touka Tsukioka, hereby vow to not change my color and...whatever else I am supposed to vow to complete Yasu’s ritual. The end.
: That’s not how the vow goes.
scene toukadownstairs11
: I don’t know how the vow goes! You haven’t told me what I’m supposed to say!
: You’re not really supposed to say anything. It’s about what you do.
: Uh-oh.
: Well, what am I supposed to do then?!
scene toukadownstairs12
: Make a baby!
scene toukadownstairs13
: I’ll give you two some privacy! Bye!
scene toukadownstairs14
: Privacy, my ass! Get back here you little evangelist! I am not losing my virginity in a dungeon!
: So, it appears that I may have been wrong when I said that we should just go along with her to see what happens.
scene toukadownstairs15
: You think?!
: Yeah. At the same time, though, now I finally get a chance to grope you. So that’s cool.
: How can you make jokes at a time like this?! We’re trapped in a dungeon and apparently not allowed to leave until I’m pregnant!
: Yeah, but you’re the one who has to carry the child. Not me.
: I will murder you!
: Touka, relax. Yasu’s not even here. We can just tell her we had sex and she’ll just...go along with it whenever she gets back, probably.
scene toukadownstairs16
: Yes, because hiding the truth from a girl who can see into the future and past is a thing that can definitely be done.
: Use your phone to call for help then. Or try and squeeze through the bars. You’re small enough. You probably can if I give you a push.
scene toukadownstairs17
: I...suppose that may be possible. This entire situation is just frustrating to me.
: I tried so hard to create an environment in which Yasu can feel normal again only to be given the harshest possible reminder of why we decided to medicate her in the first place.
: It’s one thing to be impulsive. But to throw people who care about you into situations like this is-
: It’s like it’s not her at all, right?
scene toukadownstairs18
: She was fine just hours ago...
: It wasn’t until you were brought into the picture that she started going off the rails again. I just...don’t understand what is going on between you two. How can you affect her so dramatically?
: That’s what I want to know too because there clearly is some sort of merit to it. I can’t just ignore it and call her crazy anymore.
scene toukadownstairs19
: So, what’s the plan then? Humor her and just...sit down here, wait until she comes back, then inform her that I’m carrying your child?
: If you really want to sell it, you can make some really loud sex noises. Then she really wouldn’t be able to deny that we did it.
scene toukadownstairs20
: Or we can just actually do it.
: That was obviously a joke.
: It wasn’t that obvious.
scene toukadownstairs21
: May I offer you a seat?
: May I offer you one? On my penis?
scene black
: No, I think the mattress will be just fine.
: You’d be humming a different tune if we were in your oversized bedroom, I bet.
scene toukadownstairs22
: Probably a lullaby since I’m effectively your mother and whatnot.
: Are you really going to sit like that?
: Yes. This is just how I sit. And I will not let the fact that I am in jail influence my dignity and refinement in any way.
: Suit yourself. Just think you might actually enjoy it if you try to relax a little.
: In a jail cell? With a man I have feelings for? Have you gone mad?
: Yeah. Quite a while ago, actually.
: At least you’re honest. It’s quite irritating being one of the only people in this god-forsaken city with a level head.
scene toukadownstairs23
: How does this all look to someone with a level head, exactly?
: Like utter nonsense, that’s what. You’d think I’d be used to it by now. But apparently, even constant exposure to the abnormal can’t normalize it.
: It’s chaos every day in the outside world, and I’d be lying if I said I don’t miss my bubble at times. But I suppose there are pros to this sort of exposure too.
: I’m one of them, right?
: Of course. Though, I will say that I like you more when we’re not trapped in a jail cell together.
: We’re not really trapped at all. We’re just playing charades and humoring your friend. Just like we were when she brought us down here.
: ...Yes. I suppose that’s right.
: But it doesn’t change that it feels wrong.
scene toukadownstairs24
: Which is a feeling only exacerbated by the fact that one of her dolls is staring at us from across the hall.
: Which one do you think that is?
: Don’t ask me. I’m not the one who remembers their names.
: Why do you think it’s down here?
: If I had to take a wild guess, I imagine it’s due to some other strange ritual or game Yasu’s schizophrenia has induced.
: You don’t actually think she has that, do you?
: I...don’t. Not anymore at least. But when every doctor in Kumon-mi continues to land on that as the diagnosis, I find it easier to just go along with it than to come up with a new term.
: On the bright side, though...the facility Yasu seems to have the most luck with has experienced such a thing before. Which is why I imagine we’ll keep going there from this point on.
: So long as they keep allowing me to sit in on her evaluations, that is.
: Such a thing as...as Yasu? Really? How?
: Patient confidentiality agreements unfortunately prevent me from knowing any more than the fact that they have seen someone else with her condition before.
: And I only know that in the first place because her doctor informed me.
: Can’t you just...use your money and influence to extract that information from them if it means coming closer to a potential solution? For Yasu’s sake of course.
: Yes, Yasu’s sake. I’m sure your rampant curiosity has nothing to do with it.
: Two birds. One stone.
: Unfortunately, I’m not sure I could. I had a hard enough time just getting the staff to allow me to watch. I imagine my mother would, though. She has connections there.
: That’s not surprising. She has connections everywhere.
scene toukadownstairs25
: Being the most powerful woman in the city has its perks.
: Think you can get her to pry a little bit for the sake of your friend? And my curiosity?
: Under normal circumstances, yes. But she’s been busier than normal lately thanks to...
: Thanks to something I...am supposed to keep secret.
: Well, now I have to know.
: I’m afraid that telling you wouldn’t accomplish much in the grand scheme of things. If anything, I Imagine it might put all of us at risk, actually.
: “All of us” as in-
: My family, of course. This is a personal matter. One that you needn’t-
scene toukadownstairs26
: Do you want to talk about it?
: Or should I just leave it alone?
: That’s a dirty move — placing your hand on my shoulder like that when you know you’re one of my weaknesses.
: One of my only specialties is exploiting those in every one. You’re one of the easiest, surprisingly. You’re too kind.
scene toukadownstairs27
: Hm.
: You sound like my sister.
: Yeah, I can see Tsukasa saying something like that. I’m actually the type to capitalize on it, though. She doesn’t have the heart yet.
: Oh, she has the heart. She’s extremely capable for her age. Which is...
: Precisely what...
scene toukadownstairs28
: This specific issue...entails.
scene toukadownstairs29
: What do you mean?
: Is something going on with Tsukasa?
: We...should probably...not discuss-
scene toukadownstairs30
: Ah-
: Your secret’s safe with me.
: Why, that’s not true at all.
: You’re the type of man who destroys everything he touches.
: There is nothing that is safe with you.
: This is.
: And why should I believe that?
: Because I know that revealing it to anyone will destroy my chances of ever getting you somewhere like this with your consent.
: You want me to...consent to being a prisoner?
: Mostly just...in a private room with me.
: I see...
: And you’re really not at all disturbed by the fact that you see me as a matriarch?
: You’re more disturbed by that than I am.
: That is true. I am quite disturbed. But I supposed Oedipal complexes aren’t exactly unheard of.
: You’re also not my real mother.
: What was your real mother like?
scene toukadownstairs31
: Don’t change the subject. Tell me what’s going on.
: Or what?...
: I’ll have to force it out of you.
: Don’t know...
scene toukadownstairs32
: Cute.
: So close to making me crumble, just to collapse yourself at the very end.
: I like you, Sensei...enough to open a window to my heart. But I’m afraid that I can’t open any windows to my family until I know how serious you are.
: About what?
: What do you think?
: You?
: Me.
scene toukadownstairs33
: I’ve already taken Yasu in...I have no qualms at all with...taking you in too...
: You don’t really want a peasant like me. I’m just the closest you’ve ever had to someone who won’t put up with your shit.
scene toukadownstairs34
: You’ll put up with anything I want you to.
: You might think you have a hold on me, Sensei...but I’m the one who pulls the strings here.
: If I ask you to jump...you jump.
: If I ask you to beg...you beg...
scene toukadownstairs35
: If I ask you to come...what do you do?
: Come...
scene toukadownstairs36
: Yeah?...
: You’d come for me?...
: Mhm...
: I have you wrapped around my finger...
: I’m the...one...who...
scene toukadownstairs37
: I’m suddenly...quite...dizzy...
: Isn’t it rather...hot in here?...
: Tell me what to do...Touka...
scene toukadownstairs38
: Hah...hah...do I really have to spell it out for you?
: Let’s give that fucking god what he wants...
: Yay!
scene toukadownstairs39
: Wha-
scene toukadownstairs40
: Y...Yasu! Open the door! We’ve been down here long enough!
: Or just go back upstairs for a few minutes. That works too.
: Did you spill your seed inside of her body? Have the roots begun to grow? Is the vow complete?
: No, I need more time.
: L-Lies! I...am full of his seed as we speak! Even now, the...presence of light within me moves! I can feel it! It is...spectacular!
scene toukadownstairs41
: I knew it! I knew you’d love it! Now, you can be happy! Now, an angel can be born! You shall name him Pahaliah! Just as He wants! Just as He says!
: Yes, yes! Whatever must be done! Now, release me so I can spread the word! Release me! Release me!
scene black
: Okay, Touka! Here you go! I told you it was easy! I-
scene toukadownstairs42
: How dare you lock me in a cage like some sort of...animal! Even as part of a game, this was entirely unacceptable, Yasu! You know better than this!
: You...
: You lied to me?...
scene toukadownstairs43
: Nothing grows inside of you...there is no light to be delivered...
: Yes! I did lie! Just like you lied when you said we could choose when to leave!
scene toukadownstairs44
: I...was just repeating what I heard! I don’t know all the rules! The instructions are always different! I-

: I don’t care! I will humor you as often as you want! I will take you here to communicate! But I will not allow you to take advantage of my kindness and treat me like a toy for your god! Do you understand?!
scene toukadownstairs45
: I don’t understand anything...
scene toukadownstairs46
: I don’t understand anything! I’m a useless messenger! A broken doll! I don’t deserve your kindness! I don’t deserve your love!
: Wait! No! Don’t cry! I didn’t mean it! It’s just...locking people in cells is wrong, Yasu! You can’t do that no matter what you hear! Okay?
: I just...want...to...save you! I’m sorry, Touka! I’m sorry, Sensei! I’m a failure! I’m a worm! I’m not fit for ascension!
: Yeah...yelling at her probably wasn’t the best move.
scene toukadownstairs47
: Oh, well you’re just full of excellent advice today, aren’t you?!
: AaaAaaAaHHH!! AAAaaAAAAAHHHHH!
scene black
: Yasu! No crying! Okay? Come with me. Back upstairs. We’ll get you home and into bed. Okay? Okay??
: Aaahhh...AaaaAAhh...Aaaahhhh....
: Sensei, would you mind-
: I’ll leave, yeah. Being around me is...clearly not healthy for her.
: Thank you...and...
: About that...issue I mentioned...could you please not bring it up to my mother? The idea of the two of you communicating behind my back is...well, disturbing enough to me as-is.
: Yeah. I understand.
: Get Yasu home safe, okay? And Yasu — thanks for showing me the color game. I had fun.
: Sniff...you did?...
: Really?...
: Yeah...tell Etinsib Ziwa I’d like to actually speak with him some day. I’d like to learn more about what he knows.
: Sniff...okay...I’ll tell him...
: Say goodnight, Yasu. We have to get you home.
: Goodnight...Sensei...
: Goodnight...both of you.
I leave the cathedral before either of them have the chance to follow me out.
The torches ignore me this time. So do the walls. So does everything.
But there is a single rabbit doll I pass by on my way out of the building with eyes like stained glass that follow me all the way home.
I can feel them even now that I’m lying here in bed — burning holes through the body that sleeps beside me on the way to my chest.
I imagine they won’t ever leave.
I imagine they can’t.
I imagine I’m asleep.
I am.
